0.en: 3. Speech at the close of the school year on 14 September 1810103)
0.zh: 3. 1810 年 9 月 14 日学年结束演辞103)

en: At this second prize-distribution ceremony I have again to set out, in a public speech, the history of the gymnasium during the past year.

For something that has been properly set up once, the best luck is to have no history; just as nations regard those periods that are not historical as their happiest. - The second year of study of a new institution does not of itself present to curiosity the interest that the immediate beginning gives; yet it too belongs to the time of foundation.

The founding of an institution is finished earlier than its tone and spirit have formed themselves; but for its completion it is equally essential that what at the beginning is the obeying of commands should become a habit, and that an inner, uniform bearing should form and become fixed.

Earlier representations, which belong to former relations of the public as well as of the teachers and pupils about what can and should be achieved and what is demanded and permitted, after they have been submerged in the first appearance of the new, return in the detail of the execution and, as old habits, make their power felt.

The nature of an institution only gradually turns to all its relations and ramifications; upon the first arrangement follows the assimilating penetration of the views, representations and modes of action by the whole, which constitutes its spirit.
zh: 在这第二次颁奖典礼上，我又要在一次公开演辞中陈述文科中学过去一年的历史。
对于一件一旦安排妥当的事，最好的幸运就是没有历史；各民族也都把那些不属于历史的时期看作自己最幸福的时期。——新机构的第二个学习年度，本身就不再给好奇心提供最初开始时的那种趣味；不过它也同样属于创立时期。
一所机构的设立，要早于它的语调与精神的形成；但要使它完成，同样要紧的是：开始时还属于服从命令的那种情形要变成习惯，并且一种内在的、齐一的态度要形成并固定下来。
先前那些属于旧有关系的表象——无论公众的，还是教师和学生的，即关于什么能够并且应当做出成绩、什么被要求、什么被允许的表象——在"新"首次出现这一现象中沉没之后，又在具体实施中回返，并以旧习惯的方式显出它们的威力。
一所机构的本性，要经过一段时间才转向它的一切关系与分支；而在最初的设置之后随之而来的，是整体对各种见解、表象与行动方式的同化式贯穿，这正是该机构的精神所在。

en: So this second year has necessarily had the progressive effect that teachers and pupils have become more at home in their duties, more equal to the whole, and the first run-up of the new has become a lasting seriousness. - The opinions whether the matter is indeed meant so, the attempts whether this or that cannot be avoided, especially the idle thoughts that this or that might have been otherwise, the paralysing scruples about this or that side circumstance, the bad presentiments of these and those consequences, - all these superfluous reflections, which meet every new arrangement and place themselves in the way of its operation, are struck down and forgotten by the continuing reality; the mere duration of existence on the one hand awakens belief in the matter, and on the other hand makes the duties something without reflection, something that simply is and that one no longer knows otherwise.
zh: 因此，这第二个年度必然产生了推进性的效果：教师和学生在自己的义务上更为自在，对整体更为平等，而"新"事物的第一次推动已经成为一种持久的严肃。——关于这桩事情是否当真就是如此这番意思的种种意见，关于这一点或那一点是否可以回避的种种尝试，尤其是那种"这一点或那一点本来也可以不是这样"的无聊念头，关于这一点或那一点次要情形的瘫痪般的顾虑，对这些或那些后果的恶劣预感——所有这些多余的反思，每一种新的安排都会遇到、并挡在其运作之前的这些反思，都被持续存在的现实性压下去并被遗忘；单纯存在的延续一方面唤起对这件事的信念，另一方面则把义务变成某种无需反思的东西，某种就是如此、而且人已不再知道还能另样的东西。

en: Through this second year of study the whole has in general become more interlocking in its parts; the consideration of the immediately preceding and the immediately following classes determined itself more precisely through the inspection, the bond of the divisions was knotted more tightly, and the inner connection was strengthened.

The remarks graciously issued by the royal general commissariat after last year's examination have above all fixed this type more closely, have delimited more precisely what each class has to make its aim, and through these firm demarcations have consolidated the unity of the whole through the interlocking of the parts.
The demands which the highest ordinance makes on each class are founded on this accomplished ordering of one stage after another; with every year the approximation to them can become more complete.
It has already been felt significantly in this year that the pupils had entered their next class prepared, in a calculated sequence of stages.
In the first year the teaching of some subjects had to begin in several classes at once from the first elements, e.g. in Greek and French, in arithmetic, and so forth.

In this year, on the contrary, the following class received the pupils prepared from the immediately preceding one and had only to take up and continue the thread formed according to a uniform plan; each class therefore stands at the end of this course of study on a higher stage than at the end of the previous one, and in the following year these effects must come out even more strongly.
zh: 通过这第二个学习年度，整体在其各部分之间总体上更加相互嵌合；对紧邻的前一个与后一个班级的考量，通过更精确的直观而得到确定，各分部之间的纽带结得更紧，内在的关联也加强了。
皇家总务署在去年考试之后所降旨发布的这些意见，主要把这一格局进一步确定下来，把每个班级应当以为什么为目的界定得更精确，并通过这些明确的划分，借助各部分之间的相互嵌合，使整体的统一更加巩固。
最高法令对每个班级所提出的要求，就建立在这种一个阶段接一个阶段的依次安排上；每过一年，对这些要求的切近都能更加完善。
今年已经明显地感觉到：学生们在按等级次序预先准备之后，进入了他们随后的班级。
第一年，某些科目的教学不得不在几个班级中同时从最初的基本要素开始，例如希腊文和法文、算术等等。
今年则相反，后一个班级接收的是经过前一个班级预先准备的学生，只需接过并继续那条按统一计划编成的线索；因此每个班级在这一个学程结束时的台阶，都比上一个学程结束时更高，而下一年这些效果还必须表现得更加强烈。

en: The detail of the subjects taught will be seen more closely from the list of the students, to be printed, for each class.
With respect to them only this change is to be mentioned, that in those classes where no religious instruction had hitherto obtained, it has now been introduced by most gracious orders.

In the progymnasium classes, namely, in which are the pupils who are of an age to receive instruction from the clergy in preparation for admission to the church community, this had been reckoned upon, as well as on the fact that in the gymnasium classes the pupils have completed this instruction and as members of the congregation take part in the general cultus and the instruction contained in it.

Now, however, this instruction is also given in these classes, - in proportion to the remaining spiritual education which the pupils receive in a school, and with the beginning of an opening up of more profound views than their former age and the nature of a general popular education permitted.

Besides, those pupils who have not yet entered the church community are to attend the church catechisations, partly in order to receive religious instruction of a particular confession, partly however - for those catechisations are not to be regarded as instruction alone - [in order] to be led to participation in the public cultus and to receive into young minds the impressions of devotion and edification, which the solemnity of the divine service brings with it.
It is indeed a tradition and an old custom, even if it does not lie immediately in the nature of the thing, that from schools it has been usual to make provision for the attendance at divine service.

Even though that peculiar kind of engagement with religion which does not fall within school instruction but constitutes the cultus belongs to the ecclesiastical purpose, so that the arrangement for the participation of the young in that same arrangement of the church could be the same, there is nonetheless the convenience that the schools assemble the greater part of the young anyway, and thus the arrangement for it is most easily made from them.
zh: 各班级的教学科目细则，将可从即将付印的学生名单中看得更清楚。
关于这一点，只需指出这样一项变动：在此前尚无宗教课的班级中，宗教课现已由最恩旨的命令设立。
在预科班中——在那些学生年龄已到可以从神职人员那里接受为加入教会共同体的准备性宗教课的地方——本来就以此为前提，同时还预设了这样一点：在文科中学各班，学生已修完这种宗教课，并作为教会成员参加共同的礼拜以及其中所含的教诲。
如今，这种宗教课也在这些班级中开设了——就它同学生在学校中所受的其他精神教养的关系而言，程度是相称的，并且开始开启比他们先前的年龄和一般民众教育之本性所允许的更深邃的见解。
此外，那些尚未加入教会共同体的学生，还须参加教会的教理问答课，部分是为了获得某一特定教派的宗教课，部分则——因为这些教理问答课不可仅仅看作一门课——[是为了]被引导去参加公共礼拜，并在年轻的心灵中领受虔敬与教化的印象，那是敬拜的庄严所带带来的。
学校方面通常会为参加敬拜作好安排，这确实是一种传统、一种旧有的习惯，尽管它并非直接出于事情的本性。
那种不属学校教学、而构成礼拜的对宗教的特殊从事方式，虽然属于教会方面的目的，因而使青年参加教会这一同一安排也可以成为学校的安排，但毕竟有这样一层便利：学校无论如何总把大部分青年聚集起来，所以相关的安排从学校方面来作出也最为容易。

en: Another instruction ordered by the highest authority has this year been put into execution among us, which the lateness of the season and the lack of means did not allow last year - the military exercises of the senior class of the gymnasium. - Already as an educational means this instruction is very important.

This exercise - to grasp quickly, to be present with one's sense, to carry out the command without first thinking it over this way and that, to execute it on the spot with precision - is the most direct means against the sluggishness and dispersion of mind, which takes time to let what it has heard sink into sense, and takes still more time before it comes out again and executes what it has only half grasped.

It has also shown itself on this occasion that young people who are otherwise formed for grasping, for presence of sense, whatever they want to attack, find their way into it quickly and make rapid progress. - From another consideration too the introduction of such exercises will appear very advantageous.
We have become far too accustomed to regarding every particular art and science as something specific.

The one on which we concentrated appears as a nature that we now have; the others, to which neither our calling nor an earlier education led us, as something foreign, into which that our nature can no longer enter.
The opinion therefore establishes itself that one can no longer learn such other skills or sciences.
But just as the nihil humani a me alienum puto is a fine saying with respect to morality, so in part it also has its full meaning in relation to the technical, but in relation to the scientific.
A person otherwise educated has indeed not limited his nature to something particular, but has rather made it capable of everything.

To get into a science or skill foreign to him, when it becomes necessary, belongs in fact nothing except, instead of stopping at the representation of the difficulties and the incapacity for it, simply to take the thing in hand and to tackle it.

Weapon exercises are wont to appear as something very heterogeneous to a calling to study; but the youthful mind is not far from it in itself, and such a test serves above all to tear down the representation of the partition wall which we draw around our calling. - A higher consideration is that these exercises, insofar as they do not have the purpose of drawing the studying youth away from their nearest calling, if they have a calling for it, remind them of the possibility that everyone, whatever estate he belongs to, may come into the position of defending his fatherland and his prince or of taking part in arrangements for it, - of a duty which lies in the nature of the thing, which formerly all citizens acknowledged as their own, but the thought of which has by degrees become utterly foreign to whole estates. - We will for the present, here in our place, also express our thanks to the gentlemen officers of the local national guard, who took on this military instruction with the greatest willingness and selflessness, and gave it with just as great inclination and humanity.
zh: 另一项由最高权力所命令的教学今年在我们这里付诸实施——去年因时令已晚且缺乏手段而未能进行——那就是文科中学高年级的军事操练。——仅作为教养的手段，这门教学就十分重要。
这种操练——迅速领会、让心思当下在场、不先翻来覆去地琢磨就把命令执行、当场精确地完成——是针对精神之懒散与涣散最直接的手段；这种懒散与涣散要花时间才能让所听到的东西进入心中，又要花更多时间才重新出来，把只抓取了一半的东西执行一半。
这一机会也表明：那些本来在领会与心思的当下在场方面受过训练的青年，无论要着手什么，都能很快进入其中并迅速取得进展。——从另一个角度看，引入这类操练也会显得非常有利。
我们过于习惯于把每一门特殊的技艺和科学看作某种特殊的东西。
我们所专注的那一门，看来就是我们现在所具有的那一种本性；至于其他那些既非我们的使命、也非早年的教养引领我们走进去的学问，则成了某种外在之物，我们那种本性已无法再进入其中。
于是形成这样一种看法：这类别的技能或学问已经不再学得会了。
然而，nihil humani a me alienum puto 就道德方面而言是一句漂亮的话，它在技术方面也有其充分的意义，而在科学方面则更有其充分的意义。
一个在别的方面受过教养的人，确实没有把自己的本性局限在某种特殊的事情上，反而使它有了应付一切的能力。
要在必要时进入一门对他而言陌生的学问或技能，实际上所需要的无非是：不要停在关于困难与无能的表象上，而是干脆把事情抓在手里，动手去做。

武器操练往往显得与求学的使命极为异质；但青年的精神本身离它并不远，而这样一次检验最能做到的是推倒我们围绕自己的使命所划下的那道隔墙的表象。——更高一层的考虑是：这些操练并不具有把求学中的青年从他们最近的使命上拉开的意图（如果他们以此为职业的话），它们使人想到这样一种可能：任何人，无论他属于哪一等级，都可能遇到需要保卫自己的祖国与君主、或参与为此而设的种种安排的时候——这是一项寓于事情本性之中的义务，从前一切公民都把它认作自己的义务，而对它的思想却逐渐地对整整一些等级变得全然陌生。——对于这些操练，我们要在这里、暂时向本城国民卫队的诸位军官致以我们的感谢；他们以最大的热忱与无私接下了这项军事教学，并以同样大的热忱与人道精神施以它。

en: For the instruction given in the school to become fruitful in the students, and for them to make real progress through it, their own private diligence is just as necessary as the instruction itself.
I believe that this aspect of the institution too has become firmer in this second year.
The regularity in the delivery of the written preparations and repetitions and of the other assigned exercises has increased through the serious demeanour of the teachers and has become a custom.

Nothing can be more essential than to pursue with all seriousness the evil of negligence, of lateness or of leaving work undone, and to hold it to an unalterable order, so that the delivering of what has been set at the appointed time must become something as unfailing as the rising of the sun again.

These exercises are important not only in order that what is to be learned in school should imprint itself all the more firmly through repetition, but almost still more in order that the young people should be led over from mere apprehension to active occupation, to their own effort.
For learning as mere receiving and a matter of memory is an extremely incomplete side of instruction.
On the other hand, the direction towards the young people's own reflecting and reasoning is just as one-sided, and must rather be carefully kept from them.

The pupils of Pythagoras had to keep silent throughout their first four years of study, that is, they were not to have or bring forth any original ideas and thoughts of their own; for the main purpose of education is that these own ideas, thoughts and reflections which the young are able to have and to make, and the way in which they are able to have them of their own, should be rooted out; as the will has to begin with obedience, so must the thought as well.

But if learning were restricted to mere receiving, the effect would not be much better than if we wrote sentences on water; for it is not the receiving, but the self-activity of grasping and the power to use it again which first makes a piece of knowledge our property.
If, conversely, the direction goes predominantly towards one's own reasoning, then discipline and order never come into thinking, and no connection and consistency into knowledge.

To receiving, therefore, the own effort must necessarily be added, not as an inventive producing, but as the application of what has been learned, as an attempt to manage at once with it in other individual cases, with other concrete material.

The nature of what is taught in the schools, beginning with the first grammatical determinations, is not a series of sensuous, isolated appearances, each of which would hold only for itself and would be merely an object of intuition and representation or of memory; but it is above all a series of rules, general determinations, thoughts and laws.

In these the young receive at once something which they can apply, as well as continuing material on which to apply it, - tools and weapons, in which to try themselves out on the individual, a power to cope with it. - The nature of the material and the kind of instruction, which is not the imprinting of a collection of individualities, perhaps only of a multitude of words and phrases, but a mutual passage between the individual and the general, makes learning in our institution into studying.

It was therefore, among other things, a perversion of the essence of education through the ancient languages, to want to turn the acquisition of their knowledge just as much into mere learning as suffices for a living language or as one merely learns natural-historical, technological and similar knowledge, at least in the way in which it can come to the young.
zh: 但要使学校所给的教诲在学生身上结出果实，使他们由此真正取得进展，学生私下的勤勉就同这教诲本身一样必要。
我相信，这所机构的这一个方面在这个第二年里也已稳固下来。
书面预习、复习以及其他指定作业的按时交付，由于教师们严正的态度而有所增加，并已成为一种习惯。
没有什么比重重追究懈怠、拖延或不做作业这一恶习、并把它维持在不可更改的秩序上更紧要的了；以致按时交付所指定的东西，必须成为如太阳重新升起一般必然无疑的事。
这些作业之所以重要，不只在于使学校所要学的东西通过重复而更加牢固地印入心中，而且几乎更是为了使青年从单纯的领会转向主动的作业，转向自己的努力。
因为把学习当作单纯的接受和记忆之事，是教学中最不完整的一面。
反过来，把青年引向自己的反思与推论，同样是片面的，而且反倒应当小心地使他们免于此。
毕达哥拉斯的学生必须在自己的头四个学年内保持沉默，也就是说，不得有自己的念头和想法流出来；因为教育的主要目的正在于：把青年所能够有的、能够做的这些自己的念头、想法和反思，以及他们能够从自身产生这些东西的那种方式，连根拔除；正如意志必须从服从开始，思想同样必须如此。
但如果把学习限制在单纯的接受上，其效果也好不到哪里去，就像我们把句子写在水上一样；因为使一门知识成为我们的财产的，首先并不是接受，而是抓住它的那种自我活动以及重新运用它的力量。
反过来，如果方向主要转向自己的推论，那么思维中就永远不会有训育与秩序，认识中也不会有任何关联与一致。
因此，在接受之外必然还须加上自己的努力，它不是一种发明式的创造，而是对所学之物的运用，是试着立即用它去对付别的个别情形、对付别的具体材料。
在各类学校中所教之物的本性，从最初的语法规定起，并不是一系列感性的、单个的现象——每一个都只对自身有效、不过是直观与表象或记忆的对象；而它首先是一系列规则、普遍规定、思想和法律。
在这些规定中，青年立即得到某种可以加以运用之物，也不断得到可以运用它的材料——用来在个别事物上试用自己、用来驾驭它的工具与武器、一种力量。——材料的本性以及教学的方式——它不是把一堆个别性的东西、比如仅仅一大堆词句，生硬地记诵下来，而是个别与一般之间相互往来的过渡——使在我们机构中的学习成为研究。
因此，把古代语言的掌握也变成单纯的记忆——如同对活的语言那样只需记忆、或者如同人们只需学习自然史、工艺之类的知识（至少是以它们所能传给青年的那种方式）那样——这是对教养本质的一种扭曲。

en: Because of this nature of our learning, a particular value must be placed on the pupils' own work at home and their occupation in relation to the school's instruction.

For their occupation we essentially need the co-operation of the parents, insofar as the sense of honour of the pupils in their relation to their fellow pupils, the drive to win the teachers' satisfaction and to give themselves the gratification of having done their duty, has not yet acquired sufficient strength, - most of all in the first years of attending school, where the own work cannot yet have become a habit, but also in the later years, when the desire for distraction, the outward social life, begins to touch the minds of the young men.
zh: 由于我们这种学习所具有的性质，必须特别重视学生在家中的自习与功课，以及它们同学校教学的关联。
在这件事上，我们切实需要父母的协助；因为学生在与同学的关系中的那种自尊心、那种要赢得老师的满意并为自己尽到了责任而感到满足的冲动，还没有获得足够的力度——在最初几个在校年头尤其如此，因为那时自己的作业还不曾成为习惯；在后来的年头也如此，那时追求分心、外在的社交生活开始触动青年人的心灵。

en: Connected with this is another important matter, in consideration of which the school stands in a yet more necessary relation to the domestic circumstances and has demands to make of them, namely discipline.
Here I distinguish between the discipline of manners and the education of them.
The actual discipline cannot be the purpose of the schools, but only the education of manners, and that too not with the whole range of means.
A school has not first to bring about discipline in its pupils, but to presuppose it.
We have to demand that the children come to our school already brought up.

According to the spirit of the manners of our time, immediate discipline is in any case not, as among the Spartans, a public matter, an undertaking of the state, but the business and duty of the parents, - except in orphanages or seminaries, in general in such institutions as encompass the whole existence of a young person.
Schools are partly institutes of instruction, not immediately of education; partly they do not begin with the first elements of formation, neither of knowledge nor of manners.

For attending our schools belongs quiet behaviour, habituation to continual attention, a feeling of respect and obedience towards the teachers, a decent and seemly conduct towards these as well as towards the fellow pupils.

For children into whom the domestic education was unable to plant these conditions, it should fall to the task of our institution first to bring about this discipline, to tame the roughness, to fix the desire for distraction, and to fill the children with the feeling of respect and obedience which their parents were unable to give them against themselves and therefore also against the teachers.

We have indeed found in the far greater number those qualities, fruits of a careful domestic education or rather only of a good domestic example, and in the few instances of the opposite we have also experienced the gratifying effect of school discipline.

At the same time, however, it is essential to point out that, since the nature of a school comprehends a higher purpose within itself and begins on a higher level than a general elementary school, the taking over of that first discipline where it has been neglected is to be regarded only as an attempt; and when, in the case of individuals who do not fulfil those conditions, improvement does not come about soon and roughness, undue licence and disorderliness do not give way in time, they must be handed back to the parents, so that the parents may first complete their duties towards them; and that they are to be removed from an institution whose instruction cannot thrive on unthinned ground.
zh: 与此相关的是另一件重要的事：学校出于它的缘故，更有必要同家庭生活的关系相连，并对之提出要求——这就是纪律。
我在此区分风纪的训育与对风纪的教养。
真正的训育不能是这些学校的目的，而只能是对风纪的教养，而且即使这教养也不得以全部手段来实行。
一所学校对于它的学生，不是首先要去实行训育，而是要预设训育。
我们必须要求：孩子们来到我们学校时已经受到了教养。
按照我们时代习俗的精神，直接的训育无论如何都不是——如同在斯巴达人那里那样——一种公共事务、一个国家的举措，而是父母的事务与义务——孤儿院与修习院除外，总之为那些把一个青年人的整个存在都包括在内的机构而言则另当别论。
这些学校有的只是教学机构，并不直接承担教育；有的则不从教养的基本要素开始——无论是认识的要素还是风纪的要素。
到我们学校来上学，须有安静的举止、习惯于持续的专注、对教师的尊重感与服从感，以及对这些教师和对同学都算得上得体而端庄的行为举止。
对于那些家庭教育无法把上述条件植入其中的孩子，本来该由我们机构承担起这份差事：先要实行这种训育，约束粗暴，矫正涣散的倾向，并使孩子们充满尊重感与服从感——这是他们的父母无法使他们对自己、因而也无法使他们对教师怀有的。
在绝大多数学生身上，我们确实发现了那些品质——它们是精心家庭教育的果实，或者更确切地说只是一个良好家庭榜样的果实；而在少数相反的例子中，我们也体验到了学校训育令人欣慰的效果。
同时还必须提醒：因为一所学校的本性本身包含着更高的目的，并且比一般民众学校起点更高，所以那种在缺失之处接手最初训育的做法，只能看作一种尝试；而且，如果在那些不满足这些条件的主体身上，转变没有很快到来，粗暴、放肆和杂乱也没有及时让位，他们就必须被送还给父母，由父母先在他们身上完成自己的义务；并且应当把他们从那种在未经开垦的土地上无法使其教学生长的机构中除去。

en: But if a school presupposes the discipline of manners, then the education of them is, in immediate connection with its main business, instruction, partly an indirect effect and partly a direct result.

We are indeed accustomed from a past age of representation still to separate head from heart, and to regard thinking and feeling, or whatever else this difference may be called, almost as two things independent of and indifferent to one another; the influence of instruction on character appears accordingly remote or accidental.

But the human mind, which is one, indeed does not harbour within itself such different natures; for all the one-sidedness possible in it, which relates only to the isolated subordinate powers more remote from the root of its essence, those deeper differences which meet immediately in its inmost centre cannot separate themselves up to that supposed isolation.
zh: 但如果一所学校预设了风纪的训育，那么对风纪的教养便与它的主营业务——教学——直接相联：它一部分是间接的效果，一部分则是直接的结果。
我们确实还处在过去那个表象的年代，习惯于把头脑与心分开，并且几乎把思维与感受——或者这个差别还可能叫什么——看作彼此独立、互不相干的两样本质；按照这种看法，教学对性格的影响就显得疏远或是偶然的了。
然而作为一体的人类精神，实际上并不在自身中藏着如此不同的本性；因为在它身上可能出现的一切偏狭，只涉及那些零散的、离其本质根源更远的下位力量，而那些在其最内核处直接相遇的更深差别，不可能分离到那种自以为是的孤立地步。

en: Already general education is, in its form, most intimately connected with moral education; for we must not restrict this education as such to a few principles and maxims, to a general honesty, kind-heartedness and uprightness of disposition, but must hold instead that only the person educated in general can also be a person educated ethically.
zh: 一般教养就其形式而言，已经与道德教养最为紧密地联系在一起；因为我们不能把这种教养本身仅仅限制在若干原则和箴言上，限制在一种笼统的正直、善意和诚实的心态上，而应当认为：只有受过一般教养的人，才可能是受过伦理教养的人。

en: But the school also has an immediate relation to the formation of the ethical character; yet it would lead me too far if I were to expound this still more important aspect here and to consider more closely the difference between life in the family and life in the school in this respect.

So I must also forgo expounding at greater length what is the principle among us concerning the outward tone of our treatment of the young people, what we demand of their conduct and what we believe we must leave to them, - and also how far the demands of the parents, or still more the exactions of the judging public, can go with respect to a school.

Whether it would be appropriate to explain away some misunderstandings prevailing in this matter, the time urges me to pass on to the nearest, historical observation, that according to the testimony of the teachers and according to my own conviction about discipline, I may say that it has gained greatly in firmness in this second year of study.
It is an old and long since threadbare complaint which older people are wont to make, that the young people they see growing up are always more unrestrained than they themselves were in their youth.

I have not wished to illuminate this complaint either in general or in particular application to the institutions here, but must appeal to the recollection of the local parents of the tone and manners of their own schooldays spent in those days, and leave it to their impartial comparison whether at the present time they see more examples of rude or improper conduct in their children or other pupils than their own parents saw then.
But I must point out that, if such things occur, the teachers, and still more the school boards, are often the last to learn of such things, if they learn of them at all.

Parents stand closer to the circle of their children's private conduct; the latter tell them more easily what goes on in the school or around it, they can hear many things which the latter carefully keep from the attention of the teachers and conceal.

In this respect I have to ask the parents without ceremony that, where they come to know of improper occurrences, they should communicate them to the teachers and the school board; these will feel themselves most obliged to them for it, since they can often only in this way be enabled, on the one hand, to ward off for themselves troubles and disadvantageous influences on their children, and on the other hand, to work together with the parents for this; only through the joint and concerted action of the teachers and the parents can something effective come about in the case of important, especially moral, errors.

As the parents may expect all help in this from the teachers, so too may the teachers expect the same from well-disposed parents in cases which may make it necessary to turn to them and to call upon them for co-operation.
zh: 但学校对于伦理品格的养成也有直接关系；不过，如果我在这里再展开这个更为重要的方面，并在这一着眼点上更仔细地考察家庭生活与学校生活的差别，那就太偏离主题了。
因此，我也必须放弃在此详细阐述：在我们这里，对待青年的外在态度遵循什么原则，我们对他们的举止有何要求，我们又认为必须让他们自行决定什么——以及家长的要求、或者更甚者评判公众的苛求，对一所学校可以到什么地步。
至于就此阐明其中存在的某些误解是否合适，时间催我转向那最近的历史性观察：依据教师们的证明以及我对纪律的确信，我可以说，纪律在这第二个学习年度里大大增强了稳固性。
这是一句老掉牙的抱怨，年长者们惯于发出：他们眼看着长大的青年，总比自己当年在年少时更放纵。
我不打算在这里对这种抱怨作一般性的或专门针对本地机构的阐明，而必须诉诸本地家长对自己当年在旧日学校里度过的学习岁月的语调与风气的回忆，并把这留给他们的公正比较：在今天，他们在自家孩子或别的学生身上看到的粗暴或不当举止的例子，是否比他们自己的父母当年看到的更多。
但我必须提醒：如果发生这类事情，教师们、尤其是学校管理当局，往往是最后才听说这类事情的人——如果他们终究还能听说的话。
父母离子女的私人生活圈子更近；孩子们在父母面前更容易讲述学校里及其周围所发生的事，他们能听到许多事情，而这些事情是孩子们小心地瞒过教师们的注意力、加以隐瞒的。
就此，我要不拘形式地请求家长：凡是得知有不当的事情，都应当告知教师和学校管理当局；他们会对此向家长深表谢意，因为往往只有这样，他们才能一方面为自己避免麻烦、防止对孩子的有害影响，另一方面与家长一道为此共同使劲；唯有教师与家长的共同而一致的行动，才能在重要的、尤其是道德方面的过失上产生实际的效果。
正如家长在这方面可以期待教师们的一切帮助一样，教师们在那些可能有必要向家长求助、并请他们协助配合的情形中，也完全可以期待善意家长的同样帮助。

en: Having touched on these main aspects of the inner condition, I pass over to the external arrangements and means.

If the inner condition offers little to history in this year, then the history of the material needs for the most part is still to come, or rather it has already begun, and the definite and serious intention of the highest government has already begun to be put into execution.
zh: 在触及了内在状况的这些主要方面之后，我转向外在的安排与手段。
如果说内在状况在本年度对历史几乎没有什么可供记载的，那么物质需要的历史在很大程度上还有待展开——其实它已经开始了；而最高政府那明确而认真的意图，也已经开始付诸实施。

en: The most striking external need is the improvement of the premises which were handed over to us in the well-known wholly degraded condition, which went as far as indecency.
Work is already now being done on the so necessary relief, and the premises of the gymnasium are being fitted out for its purposes and for decency.

With a view to such arrangements it is to be remembered that the school of a kingdom stands in a far-reaching connection with the course of business, and that dispositions concerning it cannot be made and expected individually, - especially in the entanglement which the substitution of new relations for older ones brings with it.
Nevertheless, more is now being done in the short space of a few years than was done before in a period of fifty years, and perhaps in a longer one.
zh: 最突出的外在需要，是改善那些交到我们手中的校舍——它们那众所周知的一败涂地的状况，甚至已经到了有失体面的地步。
目前人们已经在着手进行这项十分必要的补救，文科中学的校舍也正在为它的用途和体面而整修。
对于这类安排，须记住：一个王国的学校处在与整个办事流程的广大关联之中，因此关于它的处置不可能个别作出、个别期待——尤其是在以新的关系取代旧有关系所造成的那种纠葛之中。
尽管如此，如今在短短几年间所做成的事，比之此前五十年、也许更长的时期中所做成的，还要多。

en: With regard to further external means it is to be mentioned that the remainder of the Peyer coin cabinet has, in accordance with the highest orders, been adjudged to the gymnasium by the royal foundation administration of charity.

Isaak Peyer von Flaach and Haslach, the consulent who died on 11. November in the year 1761, had bequeathed among other legacies an excellent coin cabinet, worth some ten thousand gulden in metal content, to the former gymnasium.
Unfortunately this was never put into possession; whereby it came about that about two thirds of it, and among them the finest pieces, were sold and lost.

The remainder that has come to the gymnasium still consists of a silver and gilded cup, almost a foot high and nearly four marks in weight, with inset Roman consular coins; then 215 gold coins and 653 silver coins, all together to the value of 3013 gulden 40 3/4 kreuzer.

Thus this remainder has, at least, through the justice and action of the most gracious government, after 48 years finally reached its destiny in accordance with the benevolent intention of the founder, who deserves grateful mention here too: it has been given to the gymnasium, to serve there, especially in relation to history, for the common use of instruction.
zh: 至于其他外在的手段，还须提到：按照最高命令，佩耶钱币收藏的余部，已由王家的慈善基金管理局判归文科中学。
以萨·佩耶（冯·弗拉赫与哈斯拉赫），这位于 1761 年 11.11 去世的法律顾问，曾在众多遗赠中，把一套以金属含量计约值一万古尔登的精美钱币收藏捐赠给当时的文科中学。
遗憾的是，这套收藏从未曾被实际占有；于是其中约三分之二——而且恰恰是最精美的那些件——被卖掉并流失了。
最终归入文科中学的余部，至今尚存：一只银鎏金的杯子，高近一英尺，重近四马克，上面镶有罗马执政官时期的钱币；此外还有 215 枚金币和 653 枚银币，合计价值 3013 古尔登 40 3/4 克鲁采。
这样，这一余部至少在最恩旨政府的公正与作为之下，经过 48 年之后，终于依照这位同样值得在此致以感谢的创立者的善意意图，完成了自己的使命：它已被交给文科中学，以便在那里、特别是在与历史有关的方面，供教学作公益之用。

en: The royal general commissariat has already graciously made public and honourable mention of another addition which the gymnasium has received in its teaching materials.

The Frau Bauerreis here has indeed presented to it as a gift a collection of minerals which constitutes a systematically arranged cabinet, and to this she has added a collection of the Altdorf fossils, with many pieces of the famous and delicate Solnhofen petrifications together with a number of other pretty single specimens.

The thanks which we bring here to the generous donor are the more due to her, not only because she is the first benefactor of the gymnasium since its reorganisation, but also because the plan of our institution does not directly include this branch of science, so that such a collection could not have been taken in among the actual needs.

Now, however, through the gracious gift of this collection, made without being asked, and especially because it constitutes a whole, it has become possible to introduce our studying youth, in extra lessons, into this part of physical science which considers the silent birthing of nature in stones, this secret forming which lays down its delicate shapes unsought in the interior of the earth as a language of silence, which delights the eye, excites the understanding mind to the concept, and gives the soul an image of a quiet, regular, self-contained beauty.
zh: 皇家总务署已经恩准公开而褒扬地提到文科中学在教学器材方面所得到的另一样增添。
本地的鲍尔莱斯夫人把一套矿物收藏作为礼物赠送给了它；这套收藏构成了一座系统编排的标本室，而她还另加了一套阿尔特多夫的化石，其中有许多块著名的、雅致的索尔恩霍芬化石标本，以及不少其他漂亮的单件。
我们在此向这位慷慨的捐赠者致以的谢意，她更当受之无愧——不仅因为她是文科中学改组以来的第一位恩人，还因为我们机构的规划本身并不直接包含这一科学门类，所以这样一套收藏原本是不可能被纳入实际需要之中的。
如今，由于这份厚礼是不求自来的赠予，尤其又由于它自成一体，我们才得以在课外课上把求学中的青年引入自然哲学的这一部分：它考察石头中自然的静默孕育，考察那种秘密的造形——它在大地内部不事张扬地把自己精巧的形态安放下来，如同一支沉默的语言；它使眼目欢悦，激起有理解力的心灵去把握概念，并给心灵一幅宁静的、有规则的、内在自足之美的图像。

en: Another kind of external means is the support of those students of our institution who lack the external means for study.
The former school collections, which were organised by the vehicle of singing from house to house, had principally that aim.

Through these weekly or quarterly gifts, then the gifts at the Christmas singing, further through special gifts at Easter, to which the gentlemen preachers, as former inspectors of the schools, were wont to call from the pulpit, the charity of the local inhabitants has made its interest in the schools for study and in the purpose in particular evident, making it possible for penniless young people of talent and diligence to do enough to satisfy the calling of their nature for study.

How many, born of poor parents, have thereby been given the possibility of raising themselves above their station or of maintaining themselves in it, and of forming talents which poverty would have lulled to sleep or even allowed to take a bad direction!
How many worthy and famous men owe to these charities the luck of their life, their higher usefulness for the state and their fellow citizens, and still bless this benevolence.
zh: 外在手段的另一种形式，是对那些在我们机构中求学、却缺少外在学习手段的学生的资助。
此前那些通过挨家挨户唱诗而组织的学校募捐，主要就是为了这个目的。
通过这些每周或每季的捐款、通过圣诞唱诗时的馈赠、以及通过复活节期间的特别捐款——从前的学校视察者们，那些牧师先生们惯于从讲坛上为此发出号召——本地居民的慈善心肠显示了它对求学学校、尤其是对这一目的本身所抱的利害关系，使那些有天赋而勤奋的贫困青年有可能做到足以满足其本性对于求学的使命。
有多少出身贫寒的人借此获得了这样的可能：超越自己的境况而攀升，或在境况中维持自己，并造就出那些若无贫困便会沉睡、甚至可能走上歧路的才能！
有多少可敬而著名的人物，把他们生命中的幸运、他们对国家和同胞更高的效用，都归功于这些善行，并且至今仍在祝福这份仁慈之心。

en: Through the most gracious orders of the royal general commissariat I have received the instruction to take over the remnants of the collections which were still in stock in the various classes of the former schools up to the end of April, and earlier the remainder of the last night-singing collection, with the determination that what was in stock at the former Sebalder and Lorenzer school should benefit the students of the gymnasium, and what was in stock at the former Spitaler school the students of the real school.
The sum resulting from this for the school treasury amounted to 1190 fl.
However, this also comprehends something received from school foundations, which have been paid out here by the royal foundation administration of charity.
zh: 通过皇家总务署最恩旨的命令，我接到了指示：接收此前各校各班级截至四月底尚有存余的募捐款项，以及更早时最后一次夜间唱诗募捐的余款，并定明：原先塞巴尔德学校与洛伦策学校尚有存余的款项归文科中学的学生，原先施皮塔勒学校存余的款项归实科学校的学生。
由此归入学校经费的款项共计 1190 古尔登。
不过其中也包括一笔由学校基金捐赠而来的款项，是王家慈善基金管理局拨付到这里的。

en: According to the further most gracious orders of the royal general commissariat, on the proposals of the headship 208 fl.
13 kr. have already been distributed to such pupils (and a further 36 fl. of granted instalments of money
44 kr. still to be distributed to them), who according to the certificates and the knowledge of the teachers about their situation deserved a support.
This support consisted in ready money, in necessary school books, which were lent to them or also given as gifts, and in writing materials.

At the promotion which is now taking place, where the need of new school books arises, this use receives its further execution in accordance with the most gracious intention of the royal general commissariat and the original determination of these gifts.
zh: 根据皇家总务署进一步的恩旨命令，根据校务委员会的提议，今夏已经发放了 208 古尔登。
13 克鲁采已经发放给这样一些学生（另有已经核准的钱款分期 36 古尔登
44 克鲁采待发放给他们），这些学生按教师们的证明与对他们境况的了解，是值得给予资助的。
这资助包括现钱、必要的教科书（借给他们，或干脆作为礼物赠予），以及书写用具。
在眼下进行的升班中，新的教科书需要也随之出现；按照皇家总务署最恩旨的意图以及这些捐款最初的用途，这一资助形式将得到进一步的执行。

en: Even after this distribution which has already begun, the sum still usable for this purpose remains considerable; yet at the same time it is also the last, and the previous manner of inflows has ceased. - According to the accounts at hand, the local public let more than 5000 gulden flow annually to the schools in those voluntary gifts, of which the night-singing collection at Christmas alone amounted to 2300 to 2500 gulden, and the considerable part of it went to the benefit of the pupils; according to the accounts of the latest period, in which the number of pupils who received such benefits was already diminished in comparison with before, this part is to be reckoned at 3597 gulden.

If a quantum of the former contributions for the needs of the personnel required for the cultus and of the cantorial schools is continued, and hardly anything can flow from it to the schools, then we would place little confidence in the charity of the local inhabitants if we were to fear that they, who previously contributed so much to the support of needy students, should now all at once, after the perfecting of the educational institutions, entirely cease to do anything for this purpose.

We may entertain this fear all the less, since the children of so many parents enjoy the benefit of the improvement of these institutions and at the same time enjoy the advantage of the instruction which has so far been, and as we hope, will also in future be free of charge.

A further motive will be the gracious arrangement that, unlike before, not every pupil without distinction of need and merit receives a gift, but a distribution is made only to those who are genuinely in need. - May this exposition, which raises this subject here, not be without effect, and may noble friends of humanity take up their former benevolence again for the benefit of needy students.

The burdensome arrangement of collecting for this purpose by means of the physically and morally disadvantageous going about from house to house has been discontinued; the gifts now acquire an all the more voluntary character, since, as was usual at Easter, they used to be sent to the gentlemen preachers of the various churches for the pupils, and can now be sent to the headship of the school, which will receive them with heartfelt thanks for the students, will arrange the distribution under the gracious supervision of the royal general commissariat according to the report and the knowledge of the teachers about the needs, and will give public account every year of the receipts and their use.
zh: 即便在这笔已经开始了的发放之后，仍可为此目的动用的款项尚且可观；但它同时也就是最后的一笔了，而以往那种款项流入的方式已经停止。——据现有的账目，本地公众每年以那些自愿捐赠的形式流向学校的款项超过 5000 古尔登，其中仅圣诞时节的夜间唱诗募捐就有 2300 至 2500 古尔登，而其中相当大的一部分归学生受益；按最近一期的账目——在这一期里领取这类资助的学生人数已比先前减少——这一部分应计为 3597 古尔登。
如果以往捐款中的一份量数继续拨给礼拜所需人员的需要和唱诗班学校，而从中大概很难再有什么流到学校去，那么如果我们担心本地居民的慈善心肠——他们此前为资助困苦的求学青年出过那么大力——如今在教育机构臻于完善之后竟会就此完全停止为这一目的做些什么，我们就太不信任他们的善心了。
我们更不必有此担心，因为许多家长的孩子既享受着这些设施得到改善的成果，同时也享受着眼下——并且我们希望将来仍然——免费教学的好处。
另一项动机将是那道恩旨的安排：不像从前那样，不论需要与否、功劳如何，每个学生都得到一份，而是只向真正有需要的人分发。——但愿这篇在此引发这一话题的表述不致毫无效果，愿那些高尚的仁人志士重新拾起他们往日的慈善，为困苦的求学青年效力。
那种为这一目的而借助挨家挨户唱诗——这在身体上和道德上同样有害——来募集的麻烦办法已经取消；这些捐款现在具有更为自愿的性质，因为它们不像从前复活节时那样要转交给各教堂的牧师先生们供学生使用，如今可以直接送交学校管理处；该处将怀着感动与感激之情为学生接收这些款项，在皇家总务署恩旨的监督之下，依据教师们的鉴定与对他们需要的了解来安排分发，并且每年就收入与用途公开报告账目。

en: The status of the teachers has in this year too received a further new grace from
Royal Majesty.

The same highest authority has indeed graciously resolved to set the professors at lyceums, gymnasiums and real institutes in the class of state officials, and to extend to them the advantages of the service pragmatics, which highest grace we venerate with the most devoted thanks and in which we find a new motive to diligence in the fulfilment of our duties.
zh: 教师们的地位在今年也再度领受了一项新的恩典，来自
国王陛下。
至高的君主确实已恩准把高级中学、文科中学和实科学校的教授们列入国家公务人员的等级，并把职务上的实惠推广到他们身上；这最高的恩典，我们以最虔敬的感谢来敬拜，并在其中找到勤勉履行我们义务的新动机。

en: Of changes in the personnel of the teachers only this one has occurred, that on our side we have to regret the departure of our worthy colleague, Professor Büchner, to a post at another educational institution, where his theoretical and practical insights in the pedagogical field receive a wider sphere of activity.
His teaching load has been transferred from the beginning of the year of study to Herr Müller, a teacher of mathematics famed both for his literary writings and for his oral instruction.
zh: 在教师人员的变动中，只发生了这一件：就我们这一方而言，我们不得不惋惜我们可敬的同事——布赫纳教授先生——被安排到另一所教育机构任职，在那里他关于教育学的理论与实践的洞见将获得更宽广的作用范围。
他的授课任务自学习年度开始之日起就转交给穆勒先生——一位以文学著述和口头授课两方面都享有声誉的数学教师。

en: There are still many points left about which it might be appropriate to say something here, to speak of the organisation of the rankings, of the promotions, of the prize distributions, of the principles of these, but also of the accidents which occur in them.

But I have already occupied the attention of this highly esteemed assembly too long, and pass over to the main subject of this solemn act, namely to make known the places of advancement which the students have obtained in their classes this year; the annual marks and then especially their work in the public examination have been the basis of this.

The ranking and this making known of it shall be a reward for those who have maintained or risen in their distinction also this year, as well as an admonition to those who have fallen behind, to apply more diligence and industry in the coming year.
zh: 还剩下若干事项，在这里略作说明或许仍是切合的：比如名次评定、升班、奖品分发的组织方式，它们的原则，以及其中出现的种种偶然情形。
不过我已经让这位德高望重的集会的注意力停留得太久了，现在要转入这一隆重典礼的主要事项，即公布学生们今年在各自班级中所获得的升迁名次；这一评定是以年度评分为依据、尤其是以他们在公开考试中的表现为依据的。
这一名次评定及其公布，对今年在品第上得以保持或提升者是一种奖赏，对那些落后者则是一声告诫：来年要更加用功勤勉。

en: Those who distinguished themselves in an outstanding way and won the particular satisfaction of their superiors have now to receive a special distinction.

As you have made yourselves worthy of this distinction through your progress so far, your diligence and your conduct, so too you will remain in future, first for your fellow pupils and then in wider circles of duty, a pattern of eagerness for science, of seemly bearing, of respect for your parents, teachers and superiors, and above all of obedience to the laws, of firm attachment to the government and of loyal devotion to our king!
zh: 那些表现得尤为出色、赢得上级特别满意的人，现在应当领受一份特别的表彰。
你们既以迄今为止的进步、勤勉与举止配得上这份表彰，那么将来也应如此：首先对你们的同学、继而在更广阔的义务范围内，做一个勤于学问的榜样、一个举止得体的榜样、一个敬重父母、师长与上级的榜样，尤其是服从法律的榜样、对政府坚定不移的依恋与对我们国王赤诚效忠的榜样！

24.en: 4. Speech at the close of the school year on 2 September 1811104)
24.zh: 4. 1811 年 9 月 2 日学年结束演辞104)

en: At the time when the completed course of study was opened, it long seemed doubtful whether we should still be holding this ceremony of prize distribution for the whole institution, which we are holding today for the third time.

It cannot be called improper to mention those misgivings about an impending dissolution of the gymnasium - whether they have come true or not - since they showed at least this public effect, that the public holds such an institution, for the higher education based on the study of the classical languages, to be a necessity of this city; further, that patriotism and the interest in common affairs expresses itself in its whole activity, and that it finds an occasion and has a hope of bringing about something good.

What the newer revolutions of the times have so often brought about, indifference, hopelessness and the loss of the otherwise so powerful belief that the citizen can also be effective on behalf of the general good in his own place - what a sight of the fear-ridden interest in the common good and of the perished public life can raise more painful feelings than the sight of the corpses of cities and the ruins of once famous walls and houses, which Cicero's friend brought before his imagination as a consolation - this sight is agreeably interrupted by the appearance of a lively participation whenever a public institution held to be useful seems to be in danger.

As this city will not refuse its grateful feeling to the fellow citizens whose zeal and activity have contributed to this, so also not to the public offices which have supported these efforts, and least of all not to the justice and grace of the highest government, when the complete establishment and preservation of our institution will have been completed.
zh: 在结束的学习学程开课之时，有一段时间我们是否能继续为整个机构举行这颁奖典礼还属可疑——今天我们已是第三次举行它了。
提起当年对文科中学即将被解散的那些忧虑，并不算是不得体的——不管这些忧虑如今是否已产生后果——因为它们至少显出了这样的公共效果：公众把这样一所以古典语文研究为根基、实行更高教养的机构，视为本地城市的一项需要；此外，公共事务上的利害关系和爱国主义在其全部行动中表现出来，而且它找到了一个机会、抱有一个希望，要做成一些有益的事。
近来的时代变革如此频繁地带来的东西——冷漠、无望，以及那种本来如此有力的信念的丧失，即相信公民也能在本地为公共福祉有所作为——那种对共同事务的利害关系已然退缩、而公共生活已不再存在的样子，比起西塞罗的朋友为安慰他而呈现在他表象之中的那幅城市尸横、昔日著名的城墙房屋沦为废墟的景象，所激起的感觉更为痛切——而这一景象每逢一项被认为有用的公共机构似乎遭遇危险时，便会为一种积极参与的现象所愉快地打断。
这座城市既不会不对那些其热忱与行动对此有所贡献的市民表达感激之情，同样也不会不对那些支持了这些努力的公共机构表示感激，最不会不对至高政府的公正与恩典表示感激——等到我们机构的完全建立与保存得以完成之时。

en: This new holding of the prize-distribution ceremony, as which imposes on me the duty to contribute, through a public speech, to the public understanding of the nature and course of our institution and of its relation to the public, affords me the possibility to touch upon a further important aspect which comes into consideration in a public school, namely the relation of the school and of school instruction to the ethical formation of man as such; the meaning and the assessment of many arrangements and procedures within it depend on the nature of this relation.

Since, as I have remarked before, the discipline and moral efficacy of the school cannot extend to the whole scope of a pupil's existence, because this whole scope is not entrusted to it, its efficacy is on the one hand thereby limited, on the other hand however it receives a particular shape, and the school becomes precisely through this separation a sphere of its own.
zh: 这次再次举行颁奖典礼，使我有义务通过一次公开演辞，帮助公众了解我们机构的本性、其进程以及它与公众的关系；这也使我有可能触及在公立学校中必须考虑到的另一个重要方面，即学校与学校教学同人的伦理教养的关系；其中许多设置与做法的意义和评价，都取决于这一关系的本性。
如我此前已经指出的，学校的纪律与道德效力不可能延伸到学生存在的全部范围，因为这一全部范围并未托付给它；因此它的效力一方面由此受到限制，另一方面却获得了一种特殊的形态，而学校正是通过这种分离而成为一个独特的领域。

en: We are often accustomed to regarding as effective above all that which shows a direct intention of producing a purpose, and therefore to expect the moral effect too exclusively from immediate admonitions, from the immediate discipline of manners and from example.
But the indirect effect which instruction in arts and sciences exercises in this respect is not to be overlooked either.

Further, another aspect is almost still more important, which also belongs to the school in consideration of principles and modes of action, namely the aspect according to which principles and modes of action are brought into the mind not so much through conscious reflection as in so far as they are a substantial element in which man lives, by which he adjusts and orders his spiritual organisation, in so far as the principles come to him more than as custom and become habits.
zh: 我们常常习惯于主要把那些显示出为达致某一目的之直接意图的东西看作有效的，因此把道德效果几乎完全寄托在直接的教诲、对风纪的直接训育以及榜样之上。
但艺术与科学教学在这方面所施加的间接效果，同样不应被忽视。
此外还有另一个几乎更为重要的方面，它同样属于学校在原则与行动方式方面的考量；这个方面就是：原则与行动方式之进入心灵，不是靠有意识的反思，而是因为它们乃是一个实质性的要素，人就生活在这个要素之中，并依循它来调适和安排自己的精神组织，因为这些原则来到他身上不只是作为习俗，而且已成为习惯。

en: As regards the first, the direct instruction in moral concepts and principles, it makes up an essential part of our teaching; even the incidental content of what the young are practised in for the learning of languages contains largely such concepts, teachings and examples.

One might well grow impatient at the many moral pronouncements which are seen driven on everywhere from so many different springs, and hold a definite moral instruction to be superfluous, because with such knowing and talking all the usual passions, small susceptibilities and above all moral self-importance can so often find a place.

It nevertheless remains no less important for that reason not to rely solely on the natural development of the good out of the heart and on habituation through example without reflection, but to make the consciousness acquainted with the ethical determinations, to strengthen the moral reflections in it, and to direct it to thinking about them.

For in these concepts we have the reasons and points of view from which we give account of our actions to ourselves and to others, the guiding lines which lead us through the multiplicity of appearance and the uncertain play of feelings.

It is the privilege of self-consciousness that instead of the firmness of the animal instinct it is on the one hand arbitrary and accidental in its determinations, and on the other hand sets limits to this arbitrariness out of itself through its will.
Now the firm and binding, as against the unsteady and the contradictions of that side, are the ethical and then still more the religious determinations, of which however we do not speak for now.
Without them the universally valid, that which man ought, and the accidental, that which for the moment pleases him, collapse into the common form of something that he may like.
zh: 就第一点，即关于道德概念与原则的直接教诲而言，它构成了我们教学的一个本质部分；就连青年为学习语言而操练的那些材料，其附带的内容也大多包含着这类概念、教训与例子。
面对如此多的道德说教——人们看到它由各式各样的动力在四处推动——人们或许会感到不耐，并认定某种特定的道德教诲是多余的，因为在这样的知识与谈论中，一切常见的激情、小小的感受、尤其是道德上的自负，往往都能找到容身之处。
但正因如此，只依靠从内心自然生长出来的善、依靠不经反思的榜样来形成习惯，依然是同样不够的；重要的在于使意识与伦理的规定相认，在其中巩固道德的反思，并引导意识就此思考。
因为在这些概念中，我们有了理由和观点，用以向自己和他人交代自己的行动；有了那些指引线，使我们能穿过现象的多样性和情感的摇摆不定而得到引导。
自我意识的优势在于：它不像动物的本能那样固定，而是在其规定上，一方面是任意的、偶然的；另一方面，它又通过自己的意志从自身出发为这种任意设定界限。
而与那一侧的不定与矛盾相对的那个坚固而有约束力的东西，就是伦理的规定、尤其是宗教的规定；不过我们此刻不谈它们。
没有它们，那普遍有效的——人应当如何——和那偶然的——眼下他愿意如何——就一同坍塌为他所愿意的那种东西的共同形式。

en: It is one of the prejudices which have been spread by the enlightenment of the newer time - as it has indeed so often exchanged good old manners and deep principles, because it did not understand them, for superficial, worthless, indeed destructive maxims -, that moral concepts and sentences as well as religious teachings must not be taught to the young early, on the ground that they do not understand them and only get words into their memory.

But if we look at the matter more closely, it is easy to observe that the ethical concepts are indeed understood by the child, by the boy, by the young man in accordance with the measure of their age, and our whole life is nothing further than to learn to understand their meaning and scope ever more deeply, to see them reflected out of new and ever new examples and cases, and only in this way to recognise the many-sidedness of their sense and the determinacy of their application ever more developed.

Indeed, if one wanted, in order to make the man acquainted with them, to wait until he were wholly capable of comprehending the ethical concepts in their entire truth, then few, and those few scarcely before the end of their life, would possess this capacity.
It would be the lack of ethical reflection itself which delayed the formation of this power of comprehension and of ethical feeling.

It is the same case here as with other representations and concepts, whose understanding likewise begins with an uncomprehended knowledge, and it would be the same demand that only a field commander should know the word battle, because only he truly knows what such a thing is.
zh: 这是近代启蒙所传播的偏见之一——启蒙往往正因为不懂那良好的古老习俗和深刻的原则，便用浮浅的、毫无价值的、甚至败坏人的格言去替换它们——即：道德概念与格言、还有宗教教义，不应当早早教给青年，理由是青年并不理解它们，只是把一些词句塞进记忆里。
但若更仔细地察看此事，就容易看出：伦理的概念，按其年龄的相应程度，小孩、少年、青年确实是能够理解的；而我们整个生命的历程无非就是学习越来越深入地理解它们的意义与范围，从新的、不断新的例子与情形中看出它们的映现，并且只有这样才越来越清楚地认识其含义的丰富多样与其应用的确定分明。
的确，如果为了让人认识这些概念，非要等到他完全有能力把握伦理概念的全部真理不可，那么能具备这种能力的人将寥寥无几，而且这寥寥无几的人在生命结束之前恐怕也难以具备。
恰恰是伦理反思的缺失，会延迟这种领会能力与伦理感觉的养成。
这里的情形与其他表象和概念一样：人对它们的理解同样是从一种并不理解的知识开始的；而要求也会是同样的——仿佛只有一位统帅才该知道"战斗"这个词，因为只有他真正知道那是什么。

en: But the matter is not only about understanding; moral concepts and their expression are also to obtain a firmness in the representation of the mind; for that end they must be impressed early; they contain the leading features and the foundation of an inner, higher world, and, fixed in the young, they make a treasure which has life in itself, which strikes root within itself and keeps growing, which enriches itself through experience and also proves itself more and more for insight and conviction.
zh: 但问题不只在于理解；道德概念及其表达还要在心灵的表象中获得一种坚实性；为此就必须早早把它们铭刻在心；它们包含着一个内在的、更高世界的基调与根基，而在青年身上扎下根来之后，它们便成为一笔宝藏：这宝藏自身就有生命，在其中不断生根、不断生长，随着经验而日益丰富，并且对于见识与确信也愈发经受住考验。

en: Further, formal education is also necessary for ethical action; for such action presupposes the capacity to grasp the case and the circumstances correctly, to distinguish the ethical determinations themselves well from one another, and to make an appropriate application of them.

But this capacity is precisely what is formed through scientific instruction; for it exercises the sense of relations and is a constant passage in the elevation of the individual under general points of view and conversely in the application of the general to the individual.

Scientific education has in general this effect on the mind: to separate it from itself, to lift it out of its immediate natural existence, out of the unfree sphere of feeling and drive, and to set it in thought, through which it gains a consciousness of what is otherwise only a necessary, instinctive reaction upon external impressions, and through this liberation becomes the power over immediate representations and feelings, and this liberation constitutes the formal foundation of moral action as such.
zh: 此外，伦理行动还必需有一种形式上的教养；因为这样的行动属于这样一种能力：正确地把握实情与情势，善于把伦理的规定彼此分辨开来，并对它们作出恰当的运用。
但恰恰是这种能力由科学教学所养成；因为科学教学训练对关系的敏锐，并不断在把个别提升到普遍观点之下与反过来把普遍应用于个别之间来回过渡。
科学教养总体上对精神有这样的效果：把它同自身分离开来，把它从自己直接的自然的定在中、从感觉与冲动的不自由领域中提升出来，并把它置于思想之中；由此它对于那原本不过只是一种必然的、本能的对外在印象的反作用获得了意识，并且通过这一解放而成为支配直接表象与感觉的力量；而这一解放正是道德行为方式总体的形式基础。

en: The school, however, does not rest content with these general effects; it is also a particular ethical condition in which man dwells and in which he is practically formed by habituation to real relations.

It is a sphere which has its own material and object, its own right and law, its own punishments and rewards, and indeed a sphere which constitutes an essential stage in the formation of the whole ethical character.
The school stands, namely, between the family and the real world, and constitutes the binding connecting member of the transition from the former into the latter.
This important aspect is to be considered more closely.
zh: 学校却并不满足于这些一般效果；它同时也是一种特殊的伦理状态，人在其中停留，并在其中通过习惯于现实的关系而得到实际的养成。
它是一个领域，有自己的材料与对象，有自己的权利与法则，有自己的惩罚与奖赏；而且它还是一个在整个伦理性格的养成中占据重要阶段的领域。
学校正是处在家庭与现实世界之间，构成了从前者转入后者的那个起联结作用的中间环节。
这一重要方面值得更仔细地考察。

en: The life in the family, namely, which precedes the life in the school, is a personal relation, a relation of feeling, of love, of natural trust and confidence; it is not the bond of a thing, but the natural bond of blood; the child counts here precisely because it is the child; without any merit it receives the love of its parents, just as it has had to bear their anger without having any right against it. - In the world, on the contrary, man counts by what he performs; he has value only in so far as he has deserved it.
He gets little from love and for love's sake; here it is the thing that counts, not the feeling and not the particular person.

The world makes up a commonwealth independent of the subjective; man counts in it according to his skills and his usefulness for one of its spheres, the more he has put off particularity and been formed for the sense of a universal being and acting.
zh: 家庭中的生活——它是学校生活之前的一个阶段——乃是一种个人的关系，一种感受、爱情、自然的信任与信赖的关系；它不是某个事物的纽带，而是血缘的自然纽带；孩子之所以在这里算数，正因为他是孩子；他不曾有任何功劳，便领受着父母的爱，正如他也不曾有任何权利可以反对，便必须忍受他们的怒气。——相反，在世界中，人以他的作为算数；唯有在他配得上的时候，他才具有价值。
他从爱那里、为了爱所得的很少；在这里算数的是事情本身，而不是感受，也不是那个特殊的人。
世界构成一个不依赖主体性的共同体；人在其中以自己的技能和对其某一个领域的效用而论身价，因为他越是摆脱特殊性、越是被养成对一种普遍的存在与行动的意义的体认。

en: The school now is the middle sphere which carries the man over from the circle of the family into the world, out of the natural relation of feeling and inclination into the element of the thing.

For in the school the activity of the child begins, essentially and entirely, to receive a serious significance, in that it is no longer left to arbitrariness and chance, to the pleasure and inclination of the moment; it learns to determine its doing according to a purpose and according to rules; it ceases to be on its immediate person, and begins to count according to what it performs and to acquire a merit.

In the family the child has a right to act in the sense of personal obedience and love; in the school it has to behave in the sense of duty and of a law, and to do this and to refrain from that for the sake of a general, merely formal order, which otherwise would perhaps be permitted to the individual.

Taught in community with many, it learns to accommodate itself to others, to acquire trust in others, in people who are at first foreign to it, and to acquire trust in itself in relation to them, and in this it makes the beginning of the formation and the exercise of social virtues.
zh: 学校于是就是那个中间领域：它把人从家庭的圈子中带进世界，从感受与倾向的自然关系带进事物的要素之中。
因为在学校中，儿童的活动开始——本质地、完全地——获得一种严肃的意义：它不再听任任意与偶然、当下的快乐与倾向的支配；他学着按目的和规则来规定自己的行事；他不再单凭自己直接的人格而算数，而开始以自己的作为来论轻重，并去赢得一份功绩。
在家庭中，孩子可以出于个人的服从与爱而行事；在学校中，他则必须出于义务和一项法则而举止，并且为了一个普遍的、纯粹形式的秩序而去做这件事、而不去做那件事——那在别的情形下对个别者原本或许是允许的。
在与许多人共同受教之中，它学着迁就他人，学着对他人——那些起初对它而言陌生的人——建立信任，并学着在与他们的关系中对自己建立信任；在这当中，它迈出了社会性美德的养成与践行的第一步。

en: There now enters for man the twofold existence into which his life as such falls apart and between whose harder extremes in future he has to hold it together.
The first totality of his relation of life disappears; he now belongs to two separated circles, each of which takes up only one side of his existence.

Apart from what the school demands of him, he has a side free from its obedience, which is partly still left to the domestic relation, partly however also to his own arbitrariness and determination, - and thus at the same time he acquires a side no longer determined by mere family life, and a kind of existence of his own and particular duties.
zh: 于是，人进入了一种双重存在：他的生命整体上就分解在这两者之间，而今后他必须在两者之间那些更为严酷的极端之间把它维持在一起。
他生活关系的第一个总体性消失了；他现在属于两个分开的圈子，每一个圈子都只占用他存在的一个方面。
除了学校对他的要求之外，他还有一面不受学校管束：这一面部分仍旧留给家庭的关系，部分则也留给他的任意和自己的抉择；——由此他同时获得了一面不再由单纯的家庭生活所决定的侧面，一种属于自己的定在，以及一些专门的义务。

en: One of the consequences which follow from the nature of this relation just considered concerns the tone and the outward manner of treatment, as well as the scope of the discipline which can be exercised in an institution such as ours.
The concepts of what is to be understood especially by discipline and by school discipline have changed greatly in the course of formation.

Since education has increasingly been viewed from the right point of view, that it must be essentially more a support than a suppression of the awakening sense of self, a formation to independence, the manner has been increasingly lost both in families and in educational institutions of giving the young, in everything whatsoever, the feeling of subjection and unfreedom, of making them obey even in what is indifferent an arbitrariness other than their own, - of demanding empty obedience for the sake of obedience and of obtaining it by harshness, whereas only the feeling of love, of respect and of the seriousness of the matter belongs to it. - So too, then, must be demanded of the students of our institution: quiet and attention in the lessons, seemly conduct towards the teachers and fellow pupils, the delivery of the assigned exercises, and in general the obedience which is necessary for the attainment of the purpose of study.
But it is at the same time connected with this that conduct about indifferent things, which do not belong to the order, is left free.

In the sociability of study, in that intercourse whose bond and interest consist in science and the activity of mind, an unfree tone is least of all appropriate; a company of students cannot be regarded as an assembly of dependants, nor are they to have the mien and the behaviour of such.

Education to independence requires that the young should early be accustomed to consult their own sense of what is fitting and their own understanding, and that a sphere should be left free to them, among themselves and in relation to older persons, in which they determine their own conduct.
zh: 从所考察的这一关系的本性中得出的后果之一，涉及处事的语调、外在的对待方式，以及在像我们这样的机构中所能实行的纪律的范围。
关于"训育"与"学校训育"特别应当如何理解，这些概念随着教养的推进已经大大改变了。

由于教育越来越从正确的观点出发被看待，即它本质上应当更多是支持而非压抑正在觉醒的自我感觉，而应成为一种使人独立自主的教养，所以在家庭中正如在教育机构中一样，那种在一切事情上——即便在无关紧要的事情上——都要让青年产生屈从与不自由之感、让他们服从一种不同于他们自己任意的外在意志的做法，已经越来越被抛弃；那种仅仅为了服从而要求空洞的服从、并且用严厉去取得它的做法，也被抛弃了——因为对这件事而言，本该属于它的只有爱、尊重与对事情的严肃态度之感。——因此，对我们机构中的学生也必须要求：课堂上的安静与专注，对教师和同学得体的举止，交上所指定的作业，以及总括说来那为达到求学目的所必需的服从。
但与此同时也就意味着：对于那些不属于秩序的无关紧要之事，其行为举止是被放任自由的。
在求学的社交之中，在那种以科学与精神的行动为其纽带和利害关系的交往里，最不合适的就是一种不自由的语调；一群学生不能被视为一群仆役的集合，他们也不该有仆役那样的神态与举止。
通向独立自主的教育要求：青年要早日习惯于听取自己对得体与否的感觉和自己的知性；并且要给他们留出一个自由的领域——在彼此之间以及在与年长者的关系之中——让他们在其中自行规定自己的举止。

en: Besides this liberality, the limitation of the scope of the discipline which the school can exercise also follows from what precedes.

The student stands in the school with only one foot, and insofar as the responsibility for his private conduct does not yet fall entirely on him alone, it is not the teachers who can be called upon by the public for the special behaviour of the pupils outside the school buildings and the lessons.

Not only are the students for the greater part of their time under other powerful influences, and the school must content itself with the more general efficacy indicated above, but outside the school buildings they altogether fall back under the authority of the parents or of those who stand in the parents' place for them; it is for these to decide what freedom they allow their children, what company they permit them, what expenditure and what kinds of pleasures they grant them.
With a conduct of students which one finds fault with, one may say: they are pupils of the schools, who behave in this way; or else: they are the children of these parents, the sons of this age.
To be just in the judgement, one has to consider which consideration is the essential one in a particular case.
zh: 除了这份宽宏之外，从前面所论也可推出：学校所能实行的纪律，其范围是有限度的。
学生只有一只脚站在学校里面；就其私人行为的责任尚未完全由他独自承担而言，公众所要求负责的并不是教师——尤其是学生在校舍与课堂之外的特定举止。
学生不仅大部分时间处在别的强大影响之下，学校也必须满足于上面所说的那种更一般的效力；而且在校舍之外，他们总体上重新回到父母的权威之下，或回到那些代父母行事的权威之下；由这些人决定：给自己的孩子以多大的自由，允许他们何种交往，允许他们何种开销与何种消遣。
对于学生那些人们觉得该加以指责的举止，人们可以说：这是那些学校的学生，他们就是这样的举止；或者也可以说：这是这些父母的孩子，是这个时代的儿子。
为了在判断上公正，就必须看清在某个具体情形中哪一种考虑才是本质的。

en: So the school shares with the family in the life of the young; it is most necessary that they do not hinder one another, that the one does not weaken the authority and the respect of the other, but rather that they support one another and work together, in order to attain the common and so important purpose.
zh: 于是，学校与家庭共同分享青少年的生活；极有必要的是，两者不要彼此妨碍，不要一方削弱另一方的权威与敬重，而要互相支持、合力协作，以达成那个共同的、如此重要的目的。

en: On the other side the school has a relation to the real world, and its business is to prepare the young for it.

The real world is a fixed whole, self-connected, of laws and of institutions aiming at the general; the individuals count only in so far as they make themselves and behave in accordance with this general, and it does not care about their particular purposes, opinions and ways of thinking.

Yet into this system of universality are interwoven at the same time the inclinations of personality, the passions of particularity and the stir of material interests; the world is the spectacle of the struggle of the two sides with one another.

In the school the private interests and the passions of selfishness are silent; it is a circle of occupations, above all about representations and thoughts. - If, however, the life of the school is more free of passion, it at the same time lacks the higher interest and the seriousness of public life; it is only a quiet, inner preparation and rehearsal for it.
What comes about through the school, the formation of the individuals, is their capacity to belong to public life.
The science, the skills which are acquired reach their essential purpose for the first time in their application outside the school.

Furthermore they come into consideration in the school only in so far as they are acquired by these children; science is not further developed in it, but only what is already there is learned, and that indeed according to its elementary content; and school knowledge is something that others have long known.
The works of the school do not have their complete end in themselves, but only lay the ground for the possibility of another, of the essential work.
zh: 另一方面，学校与现实世界有一种关系，而它的任务就是使青年为进入这个世界做好准备。
现实世界是一个固定的、自成一体laws的整体，由法律和以普遍为目标的机构组成；个人唯有使自己并使自己的一举一动符合这一普遍性，才算数，而这个世界并不关心他们各自特殊的目的、意见和思想方式。
然而在这个普遍性的体系之中，同时又交织着人格性的倾向、个别性的激情以及物质利害关系的奔忙；这个世界就是双方相互角斗的场面。
在学校中，自私的私人利益与激情是沉默的；它是一个活动的范围，主要围绕表象与思想。——不过，如果学校的生活较少激情，那么它同时也就缺少公共生活中更高的利害关系和严肃性；它只是对公共生活的一种静默的、内在的准备和预演。
通过学校所成就的，即个人的教养，就是使他们能够归属于公共生活的能力。
所获得的学问与技能，唯有在学校之外的应用中才达到其本质的目的。
此外，这些东西在学校里之所以被看重的，也仅仅是因为这些孩子要习得它们；科学在其中并不得到进一步的发展，所习得的只是已经存在的东西，而且也只是就其基本内容而言；而且学校里的知识是别人早已知道的东西。
学校的工作并不在自身中有其完整的终点，而只是为一个别的、那个本质性的作品的可能性提供了根据。

en: If, however, the content of the matter which is learned in the school is something long since finished, the individuals who are only being formed for it are not yet something finished; this preliminary work, the formation, cannot even be completed, it can only reach a certain stage.

Now, just as what takes place within the circle of a family has principally its interest and its value only within that circle, in so far as it is only the value and the interest of these individuals, so the works of the school, and their judgements, their distinctions and their punishments, have a relative importance and their highest validity within this sphere.

The young are engaged in striving in the school; whoever falls behind in it still has before him the general possibility of improvement; the possibility that he has not yet found his standpoint, his true interest, or has not yet reached only the moment in which it breaks through with him.

Conversely, a young person sometimes distinguishes himself at first and makes rapid progress in the rudiments, but when the demand to penetrate more deeply comes, he falls back and resembles the rock on which the seed first sprang up cheerfully but soon dried up; on the other hand another, although he long appears like an unopened kernel, slowly in his apprehension and progress, in which yet everything digs deep and takes root in him, then breaks through to expression and facility as if all at once.
zh: 如果说在学校中所学的东西的内容早已是一件完成之物，那么正因为还在被培养的个体并非完成之物，这种前期工作、这种教养，甚至都不可能完成，它只能达到某个阶段。
正如在家庭圈子里所发生的事，主要只在这个圈子内部有其利害关系和价值，因为说到底它不过是这些个体的价值和利害关系；同样，学校的工作以及它的判断、表彰和惩罚，也只在这一领域之内具有相对的重要性与最高的效力。
青年人在学校中正投于努力之中；那些在其中落后的人，前面始终还有普遍变好的可能；还有一种可能，即他还没有找到自己的立场、自己真正的利害关系，或者还没有到达它在他身上突破的那个时点。
反过来，有时一个青年人在起初显得出众，在基本要领上进展迅速；但一旦更深一层的要求来临，他就落后了，就像那块种子起初欢欣地长出、却很快枯干的岩石；相反，另一个人虽然长时间看上去像一颗未开的核，在领会与前进上都十分缓慢，但一切都深深地钻入他之中并在他里面扎根，随后仿佛蓦然之间便突破而得以表现、变得轻松自如。

en: The judgement which the school passes can therefore be as little something finished as the man in it is finished.

The highest government has therefore commanded that, firstly, the marks of the pupils are not to be made publicly known; secondly, that expressly, when they are read to the pupils, it is to be explained at the same time that they are to be regarded as the free judgements of their teachers about them; but "no immediate influence on their future determination of life and their eventual position in the political constitution accrues to these judgements".
For just as the work of the school is rehearsal and preparation, so its judgement too is a fore-judgement; important as such a presumption is, it is not already something final.
zh: 因此，学校所作的判断，正如学校中的人尚未完成一样，绝非一件已经完成的东西。
因此，最高政府下令：第一，学生所得的评分不得公开宣布；第二，在向学生宣读评分时，须明确说明：这些评分应被视为教师们对他们所作的自由判断；而且这些判断"对未来的人生定位以及日后在政治宪法中的地位"并不产生"直接的影响"。
因为正如学校的工作只是预演和准备一样，学校的判断也是一种预判；这样重要的一个推定，终究还不是最终的结论。

en: At the end of the school year the main ranking, the determination of the place of advancement of each in his class, and the promotions into higher classes are carried out.
These too are judgements, indeed the public ones, but only general judgements about what the pupils have performed.

The still unsettled, which rules in this world of becoming, shows itself in this quite noticeably; from the comparison of the rankings of several years one easily sees how some have risen and others have remained behind. - I add one further remark about the distinction which lies in the higher places of advancement, and what has to be taken into account in their assessment.
For in fact only young people who are of the same age can be compared with one another, and the advantage belongs to him who is ahead among those of his own age.
In a class, however, it is not exactly such people who are together, for this depends on the progress made and also on the age at entry into the institution.
Now if those distinguish themselves who are older than the greater part of the same class, this is only a very relative advantage.
If, on the other hand, younger ones among the older even maintain only middle places, the advantage they have is naturally far greater.
zh: 在学年结束时，要进行主要的评定：确定每个人在其班级中所获的升迁名次，并办理升入更高班级的推荐。
这些同样也是判断，而且是公开的判断，不过只是关于学生们所完成之事的总体判断。
那种在这生成的世界中占统治地位的、尚未稳定的东西，在这里显得格外明显；从若干年评定的比较中，人们很容易看出有些人如何上升，另一些人又如何留在后面。——我再补一句关于处在更高升迁名次上的表彰的说明，以及在衡量它们时应当考虑到什么。
其实，只有年龄相同的青年之间才能彼此比较，而在同龄者中占先的那个人享有优势。
然而在一个班级中聚集的，并不恰恰是同龄的人，因为这取决于已经取得的进步，也取决于入学时的年龄。
如果那些比同一班级大多数同学年纪更大的人表现突出，那么这只是极其相对的优越。
相反，如果年纪较小者在年纪较大者之间即便只占中等名次，他们所拥有的优势自然也要大得多。

en: In any case it is to be remembered that in the higher classes the place of advancement loses more and more of its meaning; as one advances through the various classes, the body is gradually purified by the passing over into a trade or into other institutions.

Since it is strictly insisted upon that everyone do what is demanded in his class, and that passive attendance and unmotivated advancement do not occur, those who remain behind the demands of their class feel a discomfort and their unfitness for the calling of the institution, and look about for other callings, so that this effect of the school makes official intervention and expulsion for the most part superfluous of itself.
Whoever has therefore been admitted into the higher classes has on the whole passed the test and proved his worth, so that he can continue on the preparatory path to study.
zh: 无论如何须提醒：在更高的班级中，升迁名次越来越失去其意义；随着人们通过各个班级不断上进而升入更高班级，人员的成分也因转入行业或进入其他机构而逐渐得到净化。
由于人们认真坚持：每个人都必须完成其班级所要求的东西，而敷衍的出席和无缘由的升迁不予通行；因此那些落后于本班要求的人，会感到一种不适，感到自己同机构的宗旨不相宜，并开始寻找别的出路，以至于学校的这一效果在很大程度上使官方的干预和除名变得不必要。
因此，凡是被录取进入更高班级的人，总体上已经经受住了考验、证明了自己的合格，可以在通往求学的准备之路上继续前进。

en: Here I have to point out another apparent inequality.
For it can be the case, as it indeed is, that pupils in a higher class are further behind than others in a lower class.

For if those who are already advanced in age, in whom there is not special but at least sufficient worth for the higher class, are transferred thither on admission, or even promoted, if the rest of the arrangement - as in the second course of a two-year class - allows it; on the other hand, no haste is made with those who are of equal progress but still backward in age, because they need the proper time to acquire not only an adequate but a complete fitness, and also because the other maturity of reflection and conduct is lacking in them, in respect of which age does not disguise itself even with outstanding heads.

Here the leading principle is not to hurry into the higher classes; for the security and firmness in the rudiments is a main condition of being capable of the higher, but it can no longer be learned at a later age or in schools where one can no longer stay.
zh: 在这里我还须指出另一种表面上的不等同。
因为情况可能如此——事实上也正是如此——处在更高班级中的学生，反而比处在较低班级中的另一些学生更为落后。
因为那些在年龄上已经提前、虽无特别出众但对更高班级而言已足够胜任的学生，在录取时会被调入那个班级，或者在别处的安排（例如两年制班级的第二个学程）允许时予以提升；相反，对那些进度相同但年龄尚小的学生则不予催促，因为他们需要适当的时间去获得不仅是足够的、而且是完整的适格，也因为他们还缺少思考与举止上的那种成熟；就这一点而言，即便在出众的头脑那里，年龄也是隐瞒不住的。
这里的主要原则是不要急于进入更高的班级；因为在基本要领上的踏实与牢固，是能够胜任更高阶段的一项主要条件，而在较大的年龄、或在无法再停留其中的学校里，它就再也学不到了。

en: The inequality mentioned between the age of the pupils and the class in which they are, comes chiefly also from that age with which they entered the institution.

This circumstance leads me to a consideration very important for the parents, namely the wish that they should let their children, whom they want to entrust to our institution, begin their instruction in good time, in the eighth, ninth or at the latest the tenth year of their age.

For they have to remember that the duration of the whole prescribed course is in general ten years, and with the preparatory classes eleven to twelve, that a beginner, even if he is of a certain age, cannot begin in an upper but only in a beginning class, and that with the intimate connection of the stages of advancement no class may be skipped. - It is disadvantageous for young people of eleven, twelve or even more years, if they must be put into the lowest classes on account of their falling behind in Latin, while by reason of their age and of the progress they have already made they would be capable in other subjects of instruction much more advanced than can be given here.

In consequence of the fact that in some classes the course is two years, there is indeed the most welcome opportunity to let someone who quickly makes up what he has missed move up more rapidly; but whoever begins the course in the institution only in his thirteenth year or even later is, not to reckon other disadvantages, also in this [disadvantage], that he can only enter the university two, three or even four years later than would have been possible without the earlier negligence.

I would therefore like to be able to make this appeal audible to all parents who destine their children for study, or who at least want them to be taught in the elements of the education proper to our institution, not to let it hang on too long, given the demands which are at present made on students, with regard to the beginning of instruction.
zh: 前面所说的学生年龄与其所在班级之间的不等同，主要也来自他们入学时的年龄。
这一情形把我引向一项对家长极为重要的考量，即希望他们那些打算把孩子托付给我们机构的子女，不要耽搁太久，在八岁、九岁、最迟十岁上就开始接受教学。
因为他们必须记得：规定的整个学程通常为十年，算上预备班则为十一到十二年；一个初学者纵然已有一定年龄，也不能从高班开始，只能从起始班开始；而且由于升迁阶段之间内在的关联，任何班级都不得跳过。——对于十一岁、十二岁甚至年龄更大的年轻人来说，如果他们因为拉丁文落后而必须被放入最低的班级，这对他们是不利的；因为就其年龄和已经取得的进步而言，他们在其他科目上本能够接受比这里所给予的远为高深的教学。
由于有些班级的学程为两年，因此确有最值得欢迎的机会：让那些能够迅速补上所缺的人更快地上升；但一个人如果直到十三岁、甚至更晚才开始在本机构中的学程，那么——还不算别的弊病——他在这一项上也有损失：他进入大学要比不因早先的疏忽而延迟的情况晚两三年、甚至四年。
因此，我希望能向所有这样的家长发出呼吁：他们或是让孩子以求学为业，或至少希望孩子在属于我们机构自身教养的要素方面受到教育；鉴于目前对学生所提出的种种要求，可不要在开始教学这件事上耽搁得太久。

en: It remains still to mention the little that concerns the external fortunes of the institution in the past year of study.

First I have to mention the sign which our institution has received from the highest attention in that, in the lower-first class, in support of the so deserving class teacher, whom circumstances of health hinder in his full activity, the candidate for the teaching post Meyerlein, long proved in this city through his occupation with the education of youth, has been most graciously appointed as an assistant teacher.
zh: 还剩下一点关于本机构在过去这个学习年度中的外在命运的事需要一提。
首先我要提到我们的机构从至高的关注中所得到的一个标志：在初级最低班，为支持那位如此值得敬重的班主任——他因健康状况而无法从事全部工作——从事青年教育的师范生迈尔莱因先生（他早在本城以从事少年教育而经过考验）已获恩准被聘为代理教师。

en: I further mention that in this year the beginning could be made towards the acquisition of a physical cabinet; besides cosmography in the middle class, therefore, a course of experimental physics has for the first time been given in the senior class, which in the following year, when the cabinet will have attained a greater completeness, shall likewise become still more complete.
zh: 我还要提到：今年得以迈出购置一座物理标本室的第一步；因此，除了中年级开设的宇宙学之外，在高年级第一次开设了一门实验物理学课程；待这座标本室在来年达到更高的完备程度时，这门课程同样也将更加完善。

en: Of another interesting exercise which was introduced this year, the public declamation, the public has just seen a small sample which is still to be regarded as a beginning; when instruction in it has been practised more, more outward appearance and much inner effect is to be expected.
A correct, understanding reading requires an understanding, fine sense and much study; a great deal can be built upon it, or rather it presupposes a great deal.

The exercise connected with reflection in it is - on closer consideration, which however cannot be carried out here - to be valued so highly that perhaps the greater part of the ordinary instructing and explaining in elementary as in secondary schools could thereby be spared and could take on entirely the shape of that instruction, and that we may wish and hope to see this subject of teaching, when it has been more thoroughly studied, treated and practised as a principal means of formation.
zh: 今年引入的另一种有意思的练习——公开朗诵——公众刚刚看到了一次小小的示范，而这还只能看作开端；如果这方面的教学得到更多的实行，那么可以期待更多外在的表象和许多内在的效果。
一种正确而有理解的朗读，需要有理解力的、细腻的感性和大量的研习；它能据以生发出很多东西——或者更确切地说，它本身预设了很多东西。
其中那种与反思相结合的练习——仔细想来其实很值得高度评价，尽管此处无法展开——其价值之高以致：也许在民众学校和中学中，日常的教诲与解释的最大部分都可以由此省去，并完全呈现出那种教学的样子；而我们可以希望并期待，在这一科目得到更深入的研究之后，看到它被当作主要的教养手段来对待和操练。

en: I have further not to forget the grateful mention of a gift which our library has received through the kindness of the royal senior finance councillor, Herr Rot, in Munich, - as well as of another addition to our mineral cabinet, which, like the whole, we owe to the love for the young and their instruction; as is to be hoped, this collection will come into the outward state next year, to be used for instruction.
zh: 我还不可忘记怀着谢意提一提一件礼物：我们的图书馆由于慕尼黑王家高级财政顾问罗特先生的良善而得到了它；同样，我们的矿物标本室也另有增益，这整个收藏都应归于对青年及其教学的爱；如可希望的那样，这套收藏在来年将趋于完善，以便用于教学。

en: Finally it is to be mentioned that the fund which is designated for the support of the needy pupils of the gymnasium and of the real school has, in view of a permanent inflow, acquired consistency and assured continuance; a part of the quarterly citizens' subscription, which has taken the place of the former school collections chiefly dedicated to the students, has been turned towards it, and the completed separation of the foundations existing for the same purpose will procure for it another regular inflow.
This year the scholarships from that fund which were graciously granted and paid out in money to pupils of the gymnasium by the royal commissariat amount to 456 fl.
44 kr., including 36 fl.
44 kr., which still come from the authorisation of the previous year.
Furthermore 75 fl.
58 kr. have been used for school books distributed and writing materials.

The more appropriate use, namely for genuinely needy students destined for study, makes it possible to grant them substantially more than before and thereby true help, as indeed the instalments to the individuals amounted to 40, 60 and 100 fl.

Blessed be for this the pious ancestors who made foundations for such noble purposes, blessed the living fellow citizens who give contributions for the same intention, and finally the royal government, which in accordance with its justice effects and increasingly regularises the use founded on the will of the founders and contributors.
zh: 最后还须提到：那个为资助文科中学与实科学校中贫困学生而设立的基金，由于有了经常性的流入，已经获得了一致性与可靠的持续；每季度的市民认捐款项——它取代了此前主要面向求学学生的学校募捐——已有一部分被拨给它，而为同一目的而设的各项捐赠基金一旦彻底理清归属，将为它带来另一笔经常性的进款。
今年由王家专员署恩准拨给文科中学学生的该项基金助学金，共计 456 古尔登。
44 克鲁采，其中包括 36 古尔登。
44 克鲁采，这部分仍属于上一年度核准的款项。
此外还有 75 古尔登。
58 克鲁采已用于发放教科书和书写用具。
更为恰当的用途，即用于真正贫困、注定要走求学道路的学生，使得人们有可能给他们比以前多得多的资助，从而给他们真正的帮助；各人所分得的份额分别为 40、60、100 古尔登。
为此应受祝福的是那些为如此高尚的目的设立捐赠基金的虔诚先人，是那些为同一心愿而出资的在世同胞，最后是王家政府——它凭其公正使那种建立在设立者与出资者意志之上的用途得以实行，并使之日益规范化。

en: Just as hopefully we may look forward to the soon forthcoming supplementary, or as it were second, founding of the gymnasium, since the highest resolutions on the determination of the budget and the fund of the institution are expected, and we must not anticipate them by premature mention.
zh: 同样地，我们也满怀希望地期待文科中学即将到来的补充性的、或者说第二次的设立；因为人们正在等待关于确定该机构的预算与基金的至高决议，而我们不得抢先提及它们。

en: At the end of a year of study the examinations make publicly visible what has been performed in the various classes of the institution.
In the prize-distribution ceremony we appear still more publicly.
Here on one side stand the parents and their relatives, on the other the royal authority; family and state unite their interest.

In the distinctions bestowed, the family, which sees its sons growing up in the school, beholds the favourable pre-indication of their dawning luck, - the state, which sees them growing into themselves, the pre-indication of their usefulness.

For you, who here receive a distinction from the hand of the royal commissariat, a public recognition of what you have performed begins in it; you thereby begin to step out of the quiet circle of the school into a relation to the public and to the state.

The distinctions are not yet a final judgement, but a well-earned praise of your diligence, application and conduct in the past year, and an encouragement and summons for the future to fulfil the expectation which you have awakened in your families and in the state, so that the distinctions may not one day become a reproach to you, but rather remain pleasant recollections of the earlier stages, of which the following life too is to make itself worthy.
zh: 在一个学习年度结束时，考试让公众看见这所机构各个班级中所完成的东西。
在颁奖典礼上，我们出现得更加公开。
在这里，一旁是家长和亲属，另一旁是王家的权威；家庭与国家联合起它们的利害关系。
在所颁发的表彰之中，家长——他们看着自己的儿子在学校里长大成人——看到的是他们正在成形的幸运的吉兆；国家——他们看着这些少年成长起来——看到的则是他们效用的预兆。
对于你们——在此从王家专员署手中领受表彰的人来说——由此便开始了对你们所完成之事的公开承认；你们由此开始走出学校的静默圈子，同公众和同国家建立起关系。
这些表彰还不是最终的判断，而是对你们过去一年中的勤勉、专心与举止的一次当之无愧的赞扬，是对未来的一种鼓励与催促：去实现你们在家人和在自己国家那里所唤起的期待；这样，这些表彰日后就不会成为对你们的责难，而会始终是对从前各个阶段的愉快回忆——而此后的生活同样应当配得上它们。
